stories.title: PM Shehbaz assures KP governor of continued support to eliminate terrorism
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday assured KP Governor Faisal Karim Kundi of all possible cooperation on behalf of the federal government for the complete eradication of terrorism, durable peace and the welfare of the public in the province.

stories.title: Balochistan announces rewards of up to Rs250m for information on most-wanted terrorists
stories.brief: The Balochistan government has announced cash rewards ranging from Rs500,000 to Rs250 million for individuals providing credible information about the province's most-wanted terrorists. The provincial government announced the rewards through an official advertisement, a copy of which was also shared on X by Babar Yousafzai, the chief minister's assistant on home affairs.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz assures K-P governor of federal support to eliminate terrorism
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday assured Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) Governor Faisal Karim Kundi of the federal government's full support for eliminating terrorism, restoring lasting peace and ensuring the welfare of the people in the province.

stories.title: Imran wants PTI to expand political alliance, extend outreach to Fazl and other opposition parties, core committee told
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The PTI’s core committee has been informed that incarcerated party founder Imran Khan wanted it to expand its “political alliance” and extend outreach to Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and other opposition parties.

stories.title: Imran asks PTI to reach out to Fazlur Rehman, expand opposition alliance
stories.brief: According to a communiqué issued after the meeting, the committee expressed serious concern over the health of Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, and called for the implementation of the SC’s August 18 decision regarding their medical treatment.

stories.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
stories.brief: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

stories.title: The rising cost of putting food on the table in India
stories.brief: India's food inflation is broadening, squeezing household budgets.

stories.title: Tech sell-off resumes as euphoria from Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return subsides
stories.brief: Sell-off signals investors are bracing for further volatility in key AI sector driving economic growth worldwideTechnology shares led a market retreat Tuesday as caution returned after Jensen Huang’s extraordinary return to Nvidia days after he was forced to resign, with investors bracing for further volatility in a key sector driving economic growth worldwide.A day after…

stories.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
stories.brief: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.

stories.title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
stories.brief: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

stories.title: Huang’s return fails to dispel doubts as Nvidia shares drop
stories.brief: Technology shares led a market retreat on Tuesday as caution returned after Jensen Huang’s extraordinary return to AI giant Nvidia days after he was forced to resign, with investors bracing for further volatility in a key sector driving economic growth worldwide.

stories.title: PTI moves IHC for live broadcast of Al-Qadir Trust case hearing
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf (PTI) has filed a petition in the Islamabad High Court (IHC), seeking live broadcast of the appeal proceedings in the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case involving party founder Imran Khan.

stories.title: Khawaja Asif optimistic about referendum on creation of new provinces early next year
stories.brief: Asif criticised the threatening tone adopted by Naqvi towards Sanaullah, saying such remarks were inappropriate for political discourse. “I use very harsh language, and harsh language is also used against me, but threatening someone is not political language,” he said.

stories.title: Naqvi says govt has no intention of curtailing freedom of expression, warns against crossing 'red lines'
stories.brief: The Interior minister said the establishment of the Social Media Protection Regulatory Authority (SMPRA) would help the government address online crimes and ensure social media platforms respond promptly to complaints from victims. Naqvi criticised social media platforms for acting on only 47% of the government's requests to curb terrorism-related content.

stories.title: Khawaja Asif comes out in support of Rana Sanaullah amid political row
stories.brief: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif on Tuesday came out in support of Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, praising his political resilience, wisdom and loyalty to the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N).

stories.title: Imran Khan moves IHC for live-streaming of £190m case appeal
stories.brief: In a criminal miscellaneous application filed, Imran's counsel argued that the case attracted "significant public and media interest", making transparency and public access to the proceedings particularly important.

stories.title: Why tiny cars are taking off across Europe
stories.brief: Once seen as a car for elderly, rural people, tiny cars are being embraced by a younger demographic.

stories.title: What will the energy cap changes mean for my bills?
stories.brief: Regulator Ofgem is raising the cap affecting the energy bills of millions of households.

stories.title: 'I only use the washing machine on a Sunday' - how we're keeping our energy bills down
stories.brief: The BBC speaks to three people about steps they take to keep their energy bills under control.

stories.title: Households braced for soaring energy bills with new price cap to be announced
stories.brief: Domestic gas prices will rise significantly in January under regulator Ofgem's new price cap.
